class.name: FmodServer
class.brief_description: Core singleton for the FMOD Studio audio system.
class.description:
FmodServer is the central singleton that manages all FMOD Studio functionality. It handles initialization, bank loading, event creation and playback, bus and VCA control, listener configuration, global parameters, and plugins.
FmodServer is registered as an autoload singleton and can be called directly: [codeblock] FmodServer.play_one_shot("event:/UI/ButtonClick") [/codeblock]
The typical setup sequence is: [codeblock] var settings = FmodGeneralSettings.new() settings.channel_count = 1024 FmodServer.init(settings) FmodServer.load_bank("res://audio/Master.bank", FmodServer.FMOD_STUDIO_LOAD_BANK_NORMAL) FmodServer.load_bank("res://audio/Master.strings.bank", FmodServer.FMOD_STUDIO_LOAD_BANK_NORMAL) [/codeblock]

method.name: add_listener
method.description: Registers a node as a listener at the given index (0–7). FMOD will track the node's transform each update to position the listener. Prefer using [FmodListener3D] or [FmodListener2D] nodes instead of calling this directly.

method.name: banks_still_loading
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if any bank is still being loaded asynchronously. Poll this or use [method wait_for_all_loads] before playing events from freshly loaded banks.

method.name: check_bus_guid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a bus with the given GUID exists in a loaded bank.

method.name: check_bus_path
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a bus at the given path (e.g. [code]"bus:/Music"[/code]) exists in a loaded bank.

method.name: check_event_guid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if an event with the given GUID exists in a loaded bank.

method.name: check_event_path
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if an event at the given path (e.g. [code]"event:/SFX/Explosion"[/code]) exists in a loaded bank.

method.name: check_vca_guid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a VCA with the given GUID exists in a loaded bank.

method.name: check_vca_path
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a VCA at the given path (e.g. [code]"vca:/Master"[/code]) exists in a loaded bank.

method.name: create_event_instance
method.description: Creates and returns a new [FmodEvent] instance for the event at the given path. Call [method FmodEvent.start] to begin playback, and [method FmodEvent.release] when done.

method.name: create_event_instance_from_description
method.description: Creates and returns a new [FmodEvent] instance from an existing [FmodEventDescription]. Slightly faster than [method create_event_instance] when you already hold the description.

method.name: create_event_instance_with_guid
method.description: Creates and returns a new [FmodEvent] instance for the event identified by GUID.

method.name: create_sound_instance
method.description: Creates a [FmodSound] instance from a file previously loaded with [method load_file_as_sound] or [method load_file_as_music].

method.name: get_all_banks
method.description: Returns an [Array] of all currently loaded [FmodBank] objects.

method.name: get_all_buses
method.description: Returns an [Array] of all [FmodBus] objects available from loaded banks.

method.name: get_all_event_descriptions
method.description: Returns an [Array] of all [FmodEventDescription] objects available from loaded banks.

method.name: get_all_vca
method.description: Returns an [Array] of all [FmodVCA] objects available from loaded banks.

method.name: get_available_drivers
method.description: Returns an [Array] of [Dictionary] objects describing the available audio output drivers on the system.

method.name: get_bus
method.description: Returns the [FmodBus] at the given path (e.g. [code]"bus:/Music"[/code]). The bank containing the bus must be loaded first.

method.name: get_bus_from_guid
method.description: Returns the [FmodBus] with the given GUID.

method.name: get_driver
method.description: Returns the index of the currently selected audio output driver.

method.name: get_event
method.description: Returns the [FmodEventDescription] for the event at the given path (e.g. [code]"event:/Music/Level1"[/code]). The bank containing the event must be loaded first.

method.name: get_event_from_guid
method.description: Returns the [FmodEventDescription] for the event with the given GUID.

method.name: get_event_guid
method.description: Returns the GUID string for the event at the given path.

method.name: get_event_path
method.description: Returns the path string for the event with the given GUID.

method.name: get_global_parameter_by_id
method.description: Returns the current value of the global parameter with the given ID.

method.name: get_global_parameter_by_name
method.description: Returns the current value of the global parameter with the given name.

method.name: get_global_parameter_desc_by_id
method.description: Returns a [Dictionary] describing the global parameter with the given ID, including its name, ID, minimum, maximum, and default value.

method.name: get_global_parameter_desc_by_name
method.description: Returns a [Dictionary] describing the global parameter with the given name.

method.name: get_global_parameter_desc_count
method.description: Returns the number of global parameters defined across all loaded banks.

method.name: get_global_parameter_desc_list
method.description: Returns an [Array] of [Dictionary] objects describing all global parameters across loaded banks.

method.name: get_listener_2d_velocity
method.description: Returns the current 2D velocity of the listener at the given index.

method.name: get_listener_3d_velocity
method.description: Returns the current 3D velocity of the listener at the given index.

method.name: get_listener_lock
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the listener at the given index is locked and will not be automatically updated from its attached node's transform.

method.name: get_listener_number
method.description: Returns the number of active listeners currently configured in FMOD.

method.name: get_listener_transform2d
method.description: Returns the current 2D transform of the listener at the given index.

method.name: get_listener_transform3d
method.description: Returns the current 3D transform of the listener at the given index.

method.name: get_listener_weight
method.description: Returns the weight of the listener at the given index. Used for blending between multiple listeners.

method.name: get_object_attached_to_listener
method.description: Returns the [Node] currently attached to the listener at the given index, or [code]null[/code] if none is attached.

method.name: get_performance_data
method.description: Returns a [FmodPerformanceData] snapshot with current CPU and memory usage for the FMOD system.

method.name: get_system_dsp_buffer_length
method.description: Returns the current DSP buffer length in samples.

method.name: get_system_dsp_buffer_settings
method.description: Returns the current [FmodDspSettings] in use by the system.

method.name: get_system_dsp_num_buffers
method.description: Returns the current number of DSP buffers.

method.name: get_vca
method.description: Returns the [FmodVCA] at the given path (e.g. [code]"vca:/Master"[/code]). The bank containing the VCA must be loaded first.

method.name: get_vca_from_guid
method.description: Returns the [FmodVCA] with the given GUID.

method.name: init
method.description: Initializes the FMOD Studio system with the given settings. Must be called before loading banks or playing events. If auto-initialization is enabled in Project Settings, this is called automatically at startup.

method.name: is_plugin_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the plugin identified by the given handle is currently loaded.

method.name: load_bank
method.description:
Loads an FMOD Studio bank file and returns it as a [FmodBank]. The [param flag] controls the loading mode — use [code]0[/code] for the default synchronous load ([code]FMOD_STUDIO_LOAD_BANK_NORMAL[/code]).
Always load the Master bank and its strings bank before other content banks. [codeblock] FmodServer.load_bank("res://audio/Master.bank", 0) FmodServer.load_bank("res://audio/Master.strings.bank", 0) FmodServer.load_bank("res://audio/Music.bank", 0) [/codeblock]

method.name: load_file_as_music
method.description: Loads an audio file optimized for music streaming. Use [method create_sound_instance] to play it. Pair with [method unload_file] when done.

method.name: load_file_as_sound
method.description: Loads an audio file fully into memory for low-latency sound effect playback. Use [method create_sound_instance] to play it. Pair with [method unload_file] when done.

method.name: load_plugin
method.description: Dynamically loads an FMOD DSP plugin from the given path and returns its handle. The handle can be used with [method unload_plugin] and [method is_plugin_loaded].

method.name: mixer_resume
method.description: Resumes the FMOD mixer after a [method mixer_suspend] call. Called automatically when returning from background on mobile platforms.

method.name: mixer_suspend
method.description: Suspends the FMOD mixer to release audio hardware resources. Called automatically when moving to background on mobile platforms.

method.name: mute_all_events
method.description: Mutes all currently playing events.

method.name: pause_all_events
method.description: Pauses all currently playing events.

method.name: play_one_shot
method.description: Plays a one-shot event by path with no position. The event instance is created, started, and released automatically.

method.name: play_one_shot_attached
method.description: Plays a one-shot event by path attached to a node for positional audio. Position is taken from the node's transform.

method.name: play_one_shot_attached_with_params
method.description: Plays a one-shot event by path attached to a node, setting initial parameter values from the given [Dictionary] (parameter name → value).

method.name: play_one_shot_using_event_description
method.description: Plays a one-shot event from an [FmodEventDescription] with no position.

method.name: play_one_shot_using_event_description_attached
method.description: Plays a one-shot event from an [FmodEventDescription] attached to a node for positional audio.

method.name: play_one_shot_using_event_description_attached_with_params
method.description: Plays a one-shot event from an [FmodEventDescription] attached to a node with initial parameter values.

method.name: play_one_shot_using_event_description_with_params
method.description: Plays a one-shot event from an [FmodEventDescription] with initial parameter values.

method.name: play_one_shot_using_guid
method.description: Plays a one-shot event by GUID with no position.

method.name: play_one_shot_using_guid_attached
method.description: Plays a one-shot event by GUID attached to a node for positional audio.

method.name: play_one_shot_using_guid_attached_with_params
method.description: Plays a one-shot event by GUID attached to a node with initial parameter values.

method.name: play_one_shot_using_guid_with_params
method.description: Plays a one-shot event by GUID with initial parameter values.

method.name: play_one_shot_with_params
method.description: Plays a one-shot event by path with initial parameter values from the given [Dictionary] (parameter name → value).

method.name: remove_listener
method.description: Unregisters the listener at the given index that was attached to the given node.

method.name: set_driver
method.description: Sets the audio output driver by index. Use [method get_available_drivers] to enumerate valid indices.

method.name: set_global_parameter_by_id
method.description: Sets a global parameter by its numerical ID.

method.name: set_global_parameter_by_id_with_label
method.description: Sets a global labeled parameter (enum parameter) by ID using the label string.

method.name: set_global_parameter_by_name
method.description: Sets a global parameter by name.

method.name: set_global_parameter_by_name_with_label
method.description: Sets a global labeled parameter (enum parameter) by name using the label string.

method.name: set_listener_lock
method.description: Locks or unlocks the listener at the given index. When locked, the listener's transform is not updated automatically from its attached node.

method.name: set_listener_number
method.description: Sets the total number of active listeners (1–8). Increasing the listener count enables multi-listener setups such as split-screen.

method.name: set_listener_transform2d
method.description: Manually sets the 2D transform of the listener at the given index. Requires the listener to be locked first.

method.name: set_listener_transform3d
method.description: Manually sets the 3D transform of the listener at the given index. Requires the listener to be locked first.

method.name: set_listener_weight
method.description: Sets the blend weight of the listener at the given index. Weights determine how multiple listeners are blended when more than one is active.

method.name: set_software_format
method.description: Applies software format settings (sample rate, speaker mode) to the FMOD system. Must be called before [method init].

method.name: set_sound_3D_settings
method.description: Applies 3D sound settings (Doppler scale, distance factor, rolloff scale) to the FMOD system.

method.name: set_system_dsp_buffer_size
method.description: Applies DSP buffer settings to the FMOD system. Lower buffer sizes reduce latency but increase CPU load. Must be called before [method init].

method.name: shutdown
method.description: Shuts down the FMOD Studio system and releases all resources. Called automatically when the application exits.

method.name: unload_file
method.description: Unloads a file previously loaded with [method load_file_as_sound] or [method load_file_as_music].

method.name: unload_plugin
method.description: Unloads the FMOD plugin identified by the given handle.

method.name: unmute_all_events
method.description: Unmutes all events that were muted with [method mute_all_events].

method.name: unpause_all_events
method.description: Unpauses all events that were paused with [method pause_all_events].

method.name: update
method.description: Updates the FMOD Studio system. Called automatically each frame — do not call this manually unless you have disabled auto-update.

method.name: wait_for_all_loads
method.description: Blocks until all pending asynchronous bank loads have completed.
